A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BayesG study. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices support comparison, including matching material moved or renumbered in v3.

before.justification: v1 reports original SUMO traffic-control experiments, training curves, ablations, and graph/congestion case studies in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the work's original traffic-control experiments, ablations, training-loss analyses, and case studies in Section 5 and the appendices.

M1.justification: The combined objective changes from ELBO + critic loss in v1 Equation (11) to -ELBO + critic loss in v3 Section 4.2. This corrects the reported objective; the architecture and Algorithms 1–2 remain unchanged, so an implementation change is not established.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ATSC_Grid, Monaco, NewYork33, NewYork51, and NewYork167. The new environment-mapping appendix explains these existing tasks without adding an evaluated domain or scenario.

E2.justification: Both evaluate IA2C, ConseNet/Consensus, FPrint/FingerPrint, LToS, CommNet, and NeurComm. The additional sampling-method and coordination-graph comparisons in Section 6 and Table 2 are conceptual, not newly evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The stated A2C comparison settings, control intervals, episode horizons, and return metric are retained. Appendix B adds environment documentation rather than reporting a revised evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Both retain Figure 5's masking-strategy and input-feature ablations, Figures 7–9's training-loss analyses, and Figures 4, 10, and 11's congestion and graph case studies. No new robustness or sensitivity experiment is reported.

E5.justification: Both report five random seeds for averaged performance and retain the same shaded-band and individual-run presentations. v3 adds no repeated-run information, confidence-interval procedure, or significance test.

E6.justification: Figure 2's redrawing preserves the plotted training outcomes. The ablation, loss, congestion, and graph case-study results remain unchanged, as do Table 1's graph statistics and the corresponding reported findings.

T1.justification: The combined-loss sign correction in Section 4.2 aligns that expression with the stated ELBO-maximization goal. The existing definitions and Appendix A derivations otherwise remain unchanged; Appendix B's reward formula restates the previously described reward.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about stochastic local graph policies, Bayesian mask inference, joint actor–critic learning, and traffic-control performance with up to 167 agents.

C2.justification: v3 adds a maximum-entropy RL interpretation of mask regularization and expands explanations of locality and decentralized applicability. It removes v1 Appendix G's explicit limitation about evaluation being confined to traffic control; existing result interpretations otherwise remain.

D1.justification: New Appendix B explicitly documents current-phase and phase-duration observations, phase-holding/switching actions, and simulator-driven local transitions. These are additional details about the existing ATSC setup, not evidence that its implementation changed.

R1.justification: Section 6 and Appendix H substantially expand positioning against sampling-based networked MARL and Dec-POMDP coordination graphs, including explicit reasons for excluding the latter from experiments. Added references and discussion cover Anand and Qu, DCG, SOP-CG, and SAC, while the already-cited Lin et al. receives detailed comparison.

P1.justification: v3 reorders the related-work paragraphs, inserts a Discussion section and explanatory appendices, and makes small terminology and header edits. Most existing introduction, method, experimental, and conclusion prose is retained rather than extensively rewritten.

P2.justification: Figure 2 receives revised typography, ticks, and a top-positioned legend. v3 adds comparison Table 2 and relocates existing figures and algorithms; the remaining figure graphics are retained.

improvement.justification: Appendix B and Section 6/Table 2 make environment assumptions and comparison choices easier to assess, and Section 4.2 corrects the combined-loss sign. These provide a modest clarity gain, tempered by Algorithm 1 remaining inconsistent with that correction and removal of the explicit traffic-only evaluation limitation.
